column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(30)) for a communication/log record (e.g., 'COMM-98765').
A SMALLINT counting distinct IP addresses involved (e.g., 5).
A SMALLINT counting how many TOR nodes/relays were detected (e.g., 2).
An enum (VpnFlag_enum) indicating VPN usage (Yes, No, Suspected).
A NUMERIC(6,3) measuring browser fingerprint uniqueness (e.g., 592.223).
A NUMERIC(5,2) rating suspicious connection patterns (e.g., 75.50).
An enum (EncryptMethod_enum) for encryption use (Custom, Standard, Enhanced).
An enum (CommChannel_enum) describing the channel (Mixed, External, Internal).
A SMALLINT total messages in the session (e.g., 45).
An enum (CommFreq_enum) describing communication frequency (Low, Medium, High).
An enum (LangPattern_enum) describing language usage (Variable, Suspicious, Consistent).
A SMALLINT counting cryptographic or keyword matches (e.g., 3).
A SMALLINT tally of identified risk indicators or flags (e.g., 5).
FK referencing Transactions(TxRegistry) if communication is tied to a transaction.
FK referencing Products(ProdRegistry) if communication pertains to a product listing.
